report.answer_text:
McLaren’s Lando Norris won his first Formula 1 World Drivers’ Championship in 2025, beating Max Verstappen by just 2 points: 423 to 421. Norris’s teammate Oscar Piastri finished third with 410 points. (formula1.com)
The title went down to the final race in Abu Dhabi. Verstappen won the race, but Norris finished third—just enough to clinch the championship. (formula1.com)
